scope: Independent local research polygon editor and draft export; no automatic registration, human approval, model inference or G3 acceptance

input.binding: Exact versioned binding JSON exported by the research session after preview and fit byte hashes were checked
input.identifiers: stage_id is 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters; all three fingerprints are 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; target_condition is an integer 20 through 70
input.png: Bounded, CRC-checked, noninterlaced 8-bit RGB or RGBA target PNG with exact native dimensions; recompute generated_sha256 before displaying or editing
input.trust: Offline source/fit hashes are carried declarations from the export, not signatures or independent checks of those assets. Binding does not establish a live stage, authorization or stage lifetime

geometry.origin: Native image upper-left corner; x increases right and y increases down
geometry.vertices: Finite coordinates in the closed [0,width] x [0,height] image extent; no implicit clipping or CSS rounding
geometry.polygons: Simple nondegenerate polygons with at least three distinct vertices; reject self-intersections and zero-area polygons
geometry.pixel_rule: A pixel is covered when its native center (x+0.5,y+0.5) is inside by even-odd crossing or on a polygon edge. Edge membership uses absolute cross-product tolerance 1e-9 with inclusive segment extent
geometry.rasterization: Bounded scanline rasterization; display Canvas antialiasing is never used as mask data
geometry.composition: Union allowed polygons and union occluded polygons separately, then subtract occluded from allowed. Occlusion wins regardless of drawing order; unmarked pixels are zero in both masks
geometry.initial_state: No polygons and two zero masks. No default face, skin, hull, source-mask fallback or all-allowed fill

outputs.masks: Two immutable-snapshot 1024x1024 binary L8 PNGs, color type 0, bit depth 8, no interlace, only IHDR/IDAT/IEND chunks; pixels are 0 or 255 and masks are disjoint
outputs.png_encoding: Explicit grayscale scanlines and deflate, CRC checked on readback; never Canvas.toBlob or the RGBA exporter
outputs.draft: Versioned draft JSON carrying binding, native coordinate policy, polygons, reviewer name/kind/method/version, pixel counts and both PNG SHA256 values
outputs.reviewer: Name, method and version must be nonblank bounded text; reviewer_kind is explicitly selected ai or human with no default human selection
outputs.closed_flags: research_only=true; human_review_completed, identity_quality_accepted, age_quality_accepted, visual_seam_quality_accepted, years_calibrated, service_ready, production_enabled and g3_complete all false
outputs.status: draft_unsubmitted; never a ReviewInput request, quality decision, registration receipt or approval
outputs.empty_or_full_allowed: Refuse export when no allowed pixel remains or all 1024x1024 pixels are allowed, preserving the existing pipeline prohibition of all-allowed masks. Never alter pixels automatically to evade rejection

lifecycle.page: Separate research/mask-editor.html; no production UI, API, old readonly workbench or automatic registration changes
lifecycle.bridge: Research session can explicitly download current verified PNG and binding; clearReview invalidates both buttons and cached editor input
lifecycle.replacement: Starting a new input load, changing either input, clear, failed load or pagehide immediately blanks polygons, pending points, reviewer fields, decoded target, masks and object URLs
lifecycle.async: A monotonically changing operation epoch guards decoded previews, compression and downloads; stale asynchronous completions must not publish or repopulate state
lifecycle.persistence: No localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies, remote image URLs, file upload or automatic draft restoration; only explicit local downloads
lifecycle.stage_expiry: Server TTL/LRU can invalidate a stage while editing. Exports do not renew it. Return to current session and submit explicitly; server remains authoritative

acceptance.unit: Independent small-grid membership oracle, overlap priority, edge/vertex, winding, invalid/degenerate/self-crossing geometry, bounded inputs, PNG color0/CRC/zlib readback, binary/disjoint/unknown pixels, binding/hash rejection and snapshot immutability
acceptance.browser: Actual installed Chrome and Edge, loopback page, synthetic target and stage declarations only; real pointer and keyboard editing, downloads, independent PNG readback, binding replacement/clear/error and URL release. Frozen code and input pins before the first run
acceptance.scope: Engineering contract checks only; synthetic automation is not human review, real SAM generation, stable-browser service display qualification or texture/identity/age acceptance
